# 04 Render a positioned graph to an SVG DOM tree with the frozen id/class conventions

## Outcome

`renderToSVG(graph)` builds a real `SVGSVGElement` from a `PositionedGraph`: one `<g class="siren-node">`
per node (rect + text), one `<path class="siren-edge">` per edge (with an arrowhead marker), each
tagged with `data-siren-id`, and the correct starting `siren-pending` class per the graph's carried
timeline. Label text is inserted safely.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a hand-built `PositionedGraph` fixture (nodes `A`, `B`, `C`; edges `A-B`, `B-C`; `B`
  marked pending for step 1, `C` marked pending for step 2), `renderToSVG` returns an
  `SVGSVGElement` containing exactly 3 `<g class="siren-node" data-siren-id="...">` elements and
  2 `<path class="siren-edge" data-siren-id="...">` elements.
- [ ] Node `A` (not pending) does not have the `siren-pending` class; nodes `B` and `C` do.
- [ ] Every node `<g>` contains a `<rect>` sized to the node's `width`/`height` and a `<text>`
  whose `textContent` equals the node's label exactly.
- [ ] A node whose label is the literal string `<script>alert(1)</script>` renders with that exact
  string as `textContent`, and the resulting SVG contains no `<script>` element anywhere (proves
  label text is never parsed as markup).
- [ ] Every edge `<path>` has `marker-end="url(#siren-arrow)"`, and the SVG's `<defs>` contains a
  `<marker id="siren-arrow">` definition.

## Test seam

`renderToSVG(graph: PositionedGraph): SVGSVGElement` — component test under Vitest's jsdom
environment (a real DOM implementation), hand-built `PositionedGraph` fixtures.
